blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
RGB-D 3D instance detectors benefit from visual semantics, but the task-specific Faster R-CNN/ResNet branch used by IIFNet3D couples feature extraction to a separately trained 2D detector and its image-domain labels.
Replacing that branch with a frozen vision foundation model removes this task-specific dependency, but may introduce occlusion noise and a mismatch between patch features and geometry-aware detection features.
In this work, we investigate this replacement through an adaptation of DINOv3 to the instance-level fusion pipeline of IIFNet3D.
At the core of our approach is a depth-consistent feature pipeline that projects scene points into calibrated RGB-D frames, applies a metric depth-residual check, averages the accepted DINOv3 features into an offline point cache, and aggregates the cached features inside proposal-aligned RoI grids.
The geometric and bidirectional instance-fusion paths are preserved, while Conservative VAID is evaluated as a low-strength, support-weighted semantic distillation recipe applied only to positive RoIs.
We conduct extensive evaluations on ScanNetV2 to assess the proposed transfer recipes.
On ScanNetV2, our DINOv3 control achieves mAP scores of 76.15 76.15 and 60.93 60.93 at IoU thresholds of 0.25 0.25 and 0.50 0.50 , respectively.
The Conservative VAID setting achieves mAP scores of 76.59 76.59 and 62.16 62.16 , corresponding to numerical gains of 0.44 0.44 and 1.23 1.23 points over the control, respectively, in this checkpoint-level recipe comparison.
The reported IIFNet3D result of 75.7 / 63.8 75.7/63.8 is used only as an external reference because the visual branch and processing protocol differ.
Accordingly, we interpret these results as evidence for a controlled transfer recipe rather than as a causal estimate of the individual contributions of VAID or depth filtering.

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Three-dimensional instance detection from RGB-D observations is central to indoor scene understanding and embodied robotics [ 1 , 2 ] .
A reliable detector must combine geometric evidence from point clouds with visual semantics that distinguish objects with similar shapes or limited geometric support.
Vision foundation models offer a promising source of transferable semantics because their frozen representations can be reused across image domains without training a task-specific image detector [ 3 ] .
Yet a general-purpose patch representation is not inherently aligned with a 3D proposal, an occluded image measurement, or a geometry-sensitive detection head.
The key challenge is therefore to adapt foundation-model features for instance-level 3D reasoning while preserving the geometric representation that supports detection.
blocks.zh:
来自RGB-D观测的三维实例检测是室内场景理解的核心,并包含机器人[1,2].
可靠的探测器必须把点云的几何证据和视觉语义结合起来,区分形状相似或几何支持有限的物体.
愿景基础模型提供了一个可转移语义的有希望的来源,因为其冷冻的表达可以跨图像域重新使用,而无需培训一个任务特定的图像探测器[3].
然而,一般用途的补丁表示与3D建议、闭合图像测量或几何敏感检测头之间没有内在的一致。
因此,关键的挑战是如何在保留支持检测的几何表达的同时,调整基础模型特征,例如3D级推理。

blocks.en:
Existing RGB-D 3D detectors exploit point-cloud geometry through voting, grouping, or point-to-image fusion; some also use image features from a task-specific 2D detector [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Instance-level fusion is attractive because each proposal can aggregate visual evidence before the 3D detection head. The original IIFNet3D branch has a useful detection prior, but it requires a dedicated 2D detector and does not provide the broad, frozen patch representation provided by DINOv3.
Introducing DINOv3 raises three unresolved issues. First, projecting a 3D sample into an RGB frame may retrieve a background patch when the sample is occluded. Second, a fixed ROI grid can provide unstable coverage for thin, boundary, or sparsely observed objects. Third, the semantic distribution of a frozen foundation model differs from that of the detection-specific visual features used to design the fusion module. Our controlled experiments show that direct cross-attention, proposal/ROI gating, residual fusion, and strong visual distillation can all reduce performance. These observations motivate explicit visibility control and task-constrained transfer rather than direct feature substitution.
blocks.zh:
现有的RGB-D 3D探测器通过投票,分组,或点对映像聚变利用点云几何;有些还使用特定任务2D探测器的图像特征[4,5,6,7]. 实例级聚变具有吸引力,因为每个建议可以在3D检测头之前集合视觉证据. 最初的IIFNet3D分支在之前有有用的检测功能,但它需要专用的2D检测器,并不提供DINOv3提供的宽宽的,冷冻的补丁表示.
引入DINOv3提出了三个未决问题。 首先,将一个3D样本投射到一个RGB框架中,在样本被占用时可能会回收一个背景补丁. 第二,固定的ROI网格可以为薄,边界,或很少观察到的物体提供不稳定的覆盖. 第三,冷冻基础模型的语义分布不同于用于设计聚变模块的检测特定视觉特征. 我们的受控实验显示,直接交叉注意,建议/ROI引子,残余聚变,以及强视蒸馏,都可以降低性能. 这些观察促使人们明确进行能见度控制和任务限制的转移,而不是直接的特征替代。

blocks.en:
We address these issues with DIFTA-3D, a depth-consistent instance-level transfer of DINOv3 within IIFNet3D.
The method replaces the task-specific visual encoder while retaining the geometric branch, the proposal ROI grid with RoI-Conv pooling, and the bidirectional GGF/SGF fusion path.
For each scene point projected into a calibrated frame, we compare the camera-space depth with the depth image and retain the visual sample only when the discrepancy between them falls below a predefined tolerance.
Accepted samples are averaged into a 384-dimensional point cache, and unobserved points are set to zero before proposal pooling.
On top of this construction, Conservative VAID uses detached DINOv3 features as teachers and applies low-strength cosine distillation only to positive RoIs, with a feature-energy support weight.
The central insight is to expose DINOv3’s broad semantics through depth-consistent instance evidence while constraining the transfer to protect the detector’s geometry, rather than treating a foundation-model feature map as a drop-in replacement.
blocks.zh:
我们用DIFTA-3D来解决这些问题,这是DINOv3在IIFNet3D内部的深度一致实例级转移.
该方法在保留几何分支的同时取代了任务特定视觉编码器,以RoI-Conv集合取代了提案ROI网格,以及双向GGF/SGF聚变路径.
对于投射到一个校准框架的每个场景点,我们将相机-空间深度与深度图像进行比较,并且只有在它们之间的差异低于预先确定的容忍度时才保留视觉样本.
接受的样本平均为384维点缓存,未观察点在建议集合前设定为零.
在这种构造之上,保守VAID使用脱落的DINov3特性作为教师,并且只对正的RoIs应用低强度的余弦蒸馏,具有特征能量支持重量.
中心洞察力是通过深度一致的例子证据来揭露DINOv3的广义语义学,同时限制移位以保护探测器的几何学,而不是将基础模型特征图作为落地替代.

blocks.en: Our ScanNetV2 checkpoint comparison illustrates this positioning. The DINOv3 control obtains 76.15 76.15 mAP@0.25 and 60.93 60.93 mAP@0.50, whereas Conservative VAID obtains 76.59 76.59 and 62.16 62.16 , respectively. Thus, the observed recipe-level difference is 0.44 0.44 points at mAP@0.25 and 1.23 1.23 points at mAP@0.50. These differences combine continuation optimization with the auxiliary recipe and are not an isolated estimate of VAID. The reported IIFNet3D result of 75.7 / 63.8 75.7/63.8 is included only as an external reference because its visual branch and processing protocol differ from those used in our experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们的ScanNetV2检查站比较表明了这种定位。 DINOv3控制得到76.15 76.15 mAP@0.25和60.93 60.93 mAP@0.50,而保守VAID则分别得到76.59 76.59和62.16 62.16。 因此,在mAP@0.25时观察到的食谱水平差为0.44 0.44分,在mAP@0.50时观察到的食谱水平差为1.23 1.23分。 这些差异将延续优化与辅助食谱相结合,并不是对VAID的孤立估计. 所报告的75.7 / 63.8 75.7/63.8的IIFNet3D结果仅作为外部参考列入,因为其视觉分支和处理协议不同于我们的实验中使用的协议。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We identify the feature-distribution and visibility mismatches that arise when a task-specific 2D visual branch is replaced by a frozen DINOv3 encoder in an instance-level RGB-D detector. • We construct depth-consistent DINOv3 instance features using calibrated depth-residual filtering and proposal-aligned RoI aggregation, and evaluate Conservative VAID as a low-strength, support-weighted semantic regularizer for positive RoIs. • We provide a controlled ScanNetV2 evaluation and a cross-dataset protocol analysis, reporting category-level behavior, high-IoU performance, and negative results for simpler transfer alternatives while separating observed recipe effects from unverified component-level causal effects.

blocks.en: II RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Point-based detectors extract local geometric evidence directly from irregular point sets, whereas voting-based methods generate object-center hypotheses from surface points [ 4 , 8 ] . Transformer-based and sparse-voxel detectors provide complementary mechanisms for modeling long-range context and operating on sparse scenes [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . These methods establish strong geometric foundations for indoor detection, but thin or weakly sampled surfaces can remain ambiguous when appearance is needed to distinguish instances.
blocks.zh: 基于点的探测器直接从不规则点集中提取局部几何证据,而基于表决的方法则从表面点产生物体中心假说[4,8]. 基于变形器和稀疏的蒸汽探测器为建立长距离上下文模型和在稀疏场景上运行提供了互补机制[9,10,11]. 这些方法为室内检测奠定了牢固的几何基础,但当需要外观来区分实例时,薄薄或微弱的采样表面可能仍然模糊不清.

blocks.en: Multimodal detectors combine point-cloud geometry with RGB semantics through point-to-pixel projection, voxel lifting, or cross-modal attention [ 5 , 6 , 12 ] . IIFNet3D performs proposal-level instance-to-instance fusion with geometry-guided and semantics-guided attention [ 7 ] . We follow this instance-level design while studying a distinct question: how to replace its task-specific visual branch with DINOv3. This replacement changes both the feature distribution and the reliability of projected evidence. We therefore retain the original fusion path and redesign the visual feature construction and adaptation protocol around depth consistency.
blocks.zh: 多式联运探测器通过点对像素投射,调伏,或跨模式注意[5,6,12],将点-云几何与RGB语义结合. IIFNet3D进行建议级实例对内聚变,并带有几何导引和语义导引注意[7]. 我们遵循这个实例层面的设计,同时研究一个独特的问题:如何用DINOv3取代其特定任务视觉分支. 这种替换既改变了特征分布,也改变了预测证据的可靠性。 因此,我们保留了最初的聚变路径,并围绕深度一致性重新设计视觉特征构建和适应协议。

blocks.en: Self-supervised vision encoders such as DINO [ 13 ] , DINOv2 [ 14 ] , and DINOv3 [ 3 ] provide patch-level representations that transfer across image domains. Their semantic breadth is useful when a task-specific 2D detector is unavailable. However, patch features are not inherently aware of 3D visibility, proposal boundaries, or the optimization behavior of a geometry-trained detector. In our setting, DINOv3 is consequently used as a frozen teacher, and its evidence is adapted at the instance level rather than used to replace the geometric representation.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的视觉编码器如DINO [13],DINov2 [14],和DINov3 [3]提供补丁级的表示,可以跨图像域传输. 它们的语义宽度在任务特定2D探测器无可用时是有用的. 然而,补丁特性在本质上并没有意识到3D的能见度,建议边界,或几何训练探测器的优化行为. 在我们的环境下,DINOv3因此被用作冷冻的教师,其证据在案例一级被修改,而不是用来取代几何表示.

blocks.en: Depth consistency and occlusion reasoning have been used to constrain image-to-3D feature lifting [ 12 , 16 ] . Our setting differs in that visibility is evaluated for proposal ROI samples across calibrated views and then used to construct an instance feature. This formulation supports explicit invalid-view handling and provides a basis for analyzing hard rejection and effective coverage, including failure modes involving thin and boundary objects. Together, these distinctions motivate our depth-consistent adaptation of DINOv3 within an instance-level 3D detector.
blocks.zh: 深度一致性和隐蔽推理被用于限制图像到3D特性提升[12,16]. 我们所处的环境不同,这种能见度在经过校准的视野中对ROI提案样本进行评价,然后用来构建实例特征。 这种提法支持明显的无效视图处理,为分析硬拒绝和有效覆盖,包括涉及薄和边界物体的故障模式提供了依据。 这些区别共同激励了我们在实例级3D探测器内对DINOv3进行深度一致的适应.

blocks.zh: 三. 概览

blocks.en: DIFTA-3D replaces the task-specific visual branch of IIFNet3D with depth-consistent DINOv3 evidence while preserving the geometric proposal path and the instance-fusion blocks. The framework comprises three stages: depth-consistent feature construction, proposal-aligned visual aggregation, and conservative semantic adaptation, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .

blocks.en:
The detector retains supervision at both stages.
The CPG objective combines focal classification, centerness, distance-IoU box regression, and Smooth-L1 voting losses.
The refinement objective combines classification, Smooth-L1 residual regression, and distance-IoU losses with weights 1 1 , 0.5 0.5 , and 1 1 , respectively; the refinement and CPG losses are summed to define ℒ det \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{det}} .
The refinement target uses the inherited regression-valid mask, and a previously negative proposal becomes positive when its maximum ground-truth IoU is at least 0.3 0.3 .
At inference, VAID supervision is omitted; the detector uses standard refinement decoding and NMS, with a pre-NMS limit of 1,000 1,000 candidates and an IoU threshold of 0.5 0.5 .

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate ScanNetV2 across its 18 classes at IoU thresholds of 0.25 0.25 and 0.50 0.50 .
The principal control uses the depth-consistent offline DINOv3 cache and the same detector configuration as Conservative VAID, but without the auxiliary loss.
The name “times=8” refers to the RepeatDataset training multiplier, not to eight RGB frames; each cached point feature may aggregate features from all frames available for its scene.
Training uses four-GPU distributed data parallelism without validation during training, and evaluation follows the corrected four-GPU protocol.
The reported IIFNet3D values serve as external references rather than same-protocol baselines because the visual branch and processing details differ.
blocks.zh:
我们评估ScanNetV2在IoU阈值为0.250.25和0.500.50的18个类别。
主控采用深度一致的离线DINOv3缓存和与Conservative VAID相同的探测器配置,但无辅助丢失.
“times=8”这个名称是指重复数据集培训乘数,而不是8个RGB帧;每个缓存点特性可能从所有可供其场景使用的帧中汇总特征。
训练使用四GPU分布式数据并行性,在训练期间不进行验证,评价遵循了修正后的四GPU协议.
由于视觉分支和处理细节不同,所报告的IIFNet3D值可作为外部参考,而不是同一议定书基线。

blocks.en:
All comparisons in this paper use the protocols and evaluators described above.
Quantities that are unavailable in an external source are omitted rather than used to support a numerical claim.
For provenance, the in-house runs use seed 0 0 , deterministic data-loader settings, and a fixed checkpoint rule with no best-checkpoint selection: each VAID recipe is evaluated after a one-epoch continuation from the archived control checkpoint.
The evaluator records the ordered AP vector, IoU threshold, checkpoint, and seed before computing mAP from unrounded values; the reproducibility artifact should expose these records, the evaluator version, configuration, and exact commands.
blocks.zh:
本文件中的所有比较都使用上述协议和评价人员。
外部来源无法提供的数量被省略,而不是用于支持数字索赔。
对于出处,内部运行使用0号种子,定点数据装载器设置,以及一个固定的检查点规则,没有最佳检查点选择:每个VAID的食谱在从存档的控制检查站持续一个时段后进行评估.
评价者在计算mAP之前,先记录所订购的AP矢量、IoU阈值、检查点和种子,然后从未圆形的数值中计算出来;可复制文物应披露这些记录、评价者版本、配置和确切命令。

blocks.en: IV-B 1 ScanNetV2

blocks.en:
ScanNetV2 contains 1,513 reconstructed indoor scenes, with 1,201 scenes for training and 312 scenes for validation.
We follow the 18-category protocol used by the IIFNet3D implementation and report mean average precision at 3D IoU thresholds of 0.25 0.25 and 0.50 0.50 .
The corrected in-house evaluator uses axis-aligned corner IoU for the ScanNet boxes and the 11-point AP calculation implemented in the archived evaluation script.
The evaluator computes each mAP from the unrounded 18-class AP vector in the same log and rounds the final scalar to two decimals; the class entries printed in Table I are independently rounded. The Table I rows were regenerated from the archived epoch-17 control and epoch-1 Conservative VAID logs.

blocks.en: IV-C Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-C 执行细节

blocks.en:
The detector is implemented with the MMDetection3D framework.
The geometric stream uses the BiResNet-based sparse 3D backbone with a voxel size of 0.02 ​ m 0.02\,\mathrm{m} .
The principal ScanNetV2 control uses AdamW with an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and learning-rate decays at epochs 9, 12, and 15 for 20 epochs.
The distributed batch uses four samples per GPU.
DINOv3 is a frozen ViT-S/16 encoder with 384-channel cached patch features; the RoI-Conv path maps each stream to 128 channels.
The principal cache uses the depth-consistency threshold specified above, and the training configuration uses a RepeatDataset multiplier of eight.
The RoI head samples a 7 × 7 × 7 7\times 7\times 7 grid, retains 128 proposals per scene, and uses kernel sizes of five and seven in its two sparse pooling stages.
Conservative VAID is initialized from the archived control checkpoint and fine-tuned for the reported screening run with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} and a loss weight of 0.01 0.01 .
The packed train and validation caches occupy 171.9480 171.9480 decimal GB, and the checkpoint used for the reported ScanNetV2 rows contains 47.5587 47.5587 million parameters. The logged peak memory is 57,570 57{,}570 MB for the control and 68,876 68{,}876 MB for Conservative VAID; an inference-throughput benchmark was not archived and is therefore not reported.

blocks.en: VI LIMITATIONS AND FUTURE WORK
blocks.zh: 六、限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Our work uses one seed and does not report multi-seed variance; the paired depth-filter and equal-budget VAID results are checkpoint-level observations.
AP0.50 is not decomposed into classification, localization, and NMS effects, and offline extraction adds storage and memory costs without an established throughput advantage.
SUN-RGBD is a protocol diagnostic, while Fast-LIVO2 is evaluated qualitatively because no 3D ground truth is available; future work will add multi-seed, visibility/localization, throughput, and annotated real-scene analyses.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作使用一个种子,不报告多种子差异;配对的深度过滤器和同等预算的VAID结果是检查站一级的观测结果。
AP0.50没有分解为分类,本地化,以及NMS效应,离线提取在没有既定的吞吐优势的情况下增加了存储和内存成本.
SUN-RGBD是一种协议诊断,而Fast-LIVO2则因为没有3D的地面真伪而被定性评价;今后的工作将增加多种子,能见度/本地化,吞吐量,以及附加说明的真景分析.
